Reapmind Innovations / August 4, 2023

How Can Automation Improve Your Loan Origination Process?

The finance industry is responsible for the investment and management of capital, as well as the provision of financial products and services to consumers and businesses. In 2016, the finance industry was worth $11.9 trillion, making it the fifth-largest sector of the global economy.

The finance industry is made up of several different sectors, including insurance, investment, banking, and securities. Insurance companies protect against financial losses, while investment firms provide investors with opportunities to invest in a variety of assets. Banks provide consumers and businesses with loans, while securities firms offer products such as stocks and bonds. Among all the mentioned segments of the finance industry, the loan is one deemed to be one of the most hectic and time-consuming processes and also the one for which customers are seeking an effective and swift way.

Various start-ups have incepted the idea of a loan disbursement within seconds by using digital technologies. Most finance companies are now heading towards mobile app development companies in India to get the best solution for the development of Loan Management Software to Automate Your Lending Process.

Why choose loan process automation?

A loan process automation system can help you streamline the loan approval process by automating tasks such as:

– Gathering information from borrowers

– Reviewing and processing applications

– Completing loan approvals

– Notifying applicants of approval or denial

This can save you time and money, as well as help to improve the accuracy and speed of the approval process. By automating these tasks, you can focus on more important tasks, such as providing quality customer service. Loan process automation can also help you to improve compliance with regulations, such as the Fair Credit Reporting Act.

How to develop loan process automation software?

To develop an effective and elite loan process automation software you need to consider several aspects that makes your process easy and enhance customer experience. A few major aspects are:

Scalability: As businesses grow, the number and complexity of their business applications increase. This can present a scalability challenge for organizations, as the number of users and the amount of data processed by these applications can quickly outpace the resources available to the organization.

Scalability issues can manifest in several ways. For example, if an application relies on a large number of external data sources, scaling that application can become difficult if those sources are not available in quantity or quality when needed. Diversity in services is the most important aspect for a business to grow along with the changing time. therefore, businesses need a solution that allows them to grow their operations and make loan management easier.

  1. Ease of deployment:

Deploying an app can be a daunting task. It can take hours or even days to set up the proper environment and deploy the app. However, several tools and techniques can make the process much easier.

One of the most important things to remember when deploying an app is to make sure that you have proper development and staging environment. This will allow you to test the app before you deploy it to the production environment.

  1. Integrated solution:

A money lending business deals with various operational levels to ensure a seamless loan process which includes onboarding customers, background verification, the credit assessment, underwriting, repayment, NOC, and more. To automate the entire loan procedure, you need to develop an app integrated with features enabling each process automation.

  1. Centralized access:

Loan Management Software to Automate Your Lending Process will allow you to store complete details of the customers on the digital platform. If you choose to connect your app with the cloud solution then it also allows you to make your data centralized with complete security. Now, anyone with the authentications can access the data, making your process global and seamless. This offers a 360-degree customer profile with easy access.

  1. Process automation:

The major question that comes to mind is “How Automation Can Improve Your Loan Origination Process?”

Developing an RPA for the loan process can help you automate almost mundane tasks and hence enhancing your productivity and service efficiency. You can easily map all your operations to an RPA, such as loan evaluation, analyzing the credit score of the applicant, and more.

Cost to develop loan process automation software

The loan process automation software cost depends on various aspects but the two important among those are features incorporated and the developer you are hiring for your app development. If you are choosing a basic loan process automation app then it will cost you approx. $20000-$40000. The mentioned cost may vary based on the selection of your developer. The cost to hire a loan process automation software developer change with the location, such as:

Australia: $100-$170 per hour

Eastern Europe: $50-$120 per hour

Western Europe: $100-$200 per hour

North America: $50-$120 per hour

South America: $50-$120 per hour

India: $30-$120 per hour

FAQ’s

What is loan process automation software?

It is an application that will help you to automate the end-to-end loan process that includes documentation, credit verification, loan eligibility approval, disbursement of the loan, underwriting, and more.

Which business segments can opt for a loan process automation software?

Loan process automation software can be useful for the various business arenas, such as:

– Investment broker

– Angel investors

– Investment and stock firm

– Venture capital

– Start-up incubators

– Loan consulting businesses

– Financial institute

What are the major features required to develop loan process automation software?

The major features of a loan process automation software are:

– Accountability

– Speed

– Scalability

– Dynamic functionality

– CIBIL analysis
